verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs describe event-driven triggers that draft replies when emails arrive, organize threads into todos and connect to 3,000+ apps. Custom plain-English AI filters automatically label, star and archive mail, which together form user-configured automations that run without manual invocation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of trigger setup and limits, recurring time-based scheduling of automations (only event triggers are evidenced), run logs or monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these run reliably in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.
Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
Shortwave now integrates with Tasklet to take action on your emails automatically.
